scenarios.name: Navigate to and open the client registration page
scenarios.criteria: Clicking Join Healing Sky and selecting Join as a Client successfully loads the client registration page.

scenarios.name: Fill out and submit the client registration form
scenarios.criteria: Submitting the client registration form with valid details displays a success or confirmation message.
scenarios.endState: Registration confirmation is shown or user is redirected to a success page.

scenarios.name: Navigate to client sign-in page and initiate login with Email OTP
scenarios.criteria: Using the configured client email and selecting Email as OTP delivery method displays the OTP verification screen.
scenarios.endState: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.

scenarios.name: Enter OTP and access the authenticated client dashboard
scenarios.criteria: Entering the configured OTP and clicking Verify successfully navigates to the authenticated client dashboard.
preconditions: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.
scenarios.startState: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.

scenarios.name: Log out from the authenticated client dashboard
scenarios.criteria: Clicking Log Out from the authenticated client dashboard successfully logs out the user and navigates to the Healing Sky homepage.
